disabilities.condition.blind.you: You only see a couple of blocks, sky included. Whatever makes a noise lights up for a moment; tap the white cane (right click) to see around you for a few seconds. Without the cane in your hand you walk into walls.
disabilities.condition.blind.others: Dark glasses and a white cane sweeping and tapping the ground.
disabilities.condition.achromatopsia.you: Everything is black and white, inventory included: diamonds, emeralds and redstone look alike. The sun dazzles you: you need a helmet.
disabilities.condition.achromatopsia.oth: Glasses with pink lenses; in the sun you shade your eyes with your hand.
disabilities.condition.myopia.you: Anything more than a few blocks away is a blur. A hard hit knocks your glasses off and for half a minute you can hardly see.
disabilities.condition.myopia.others: Thick glasses and the head pushed forward; they see you lose your glasses.
disabilities.condition.one_eye.you: Half of the screen is dark.
disabilities.condition.one_eye.others: An eye patch and a tilted head.
disabilities.condition.albinism.you: Sunlight blinds and burns you: outdoors by day you need a helmet.
disabilities.condition.albinism.others: White hair and very pale skin; in the sun you smoke, turn red and shade your eyes with your hand.
disabilities.condition.deaf.you: You hear no sound at all.
disabilities.condition.deaf.others: Hearing aids; when someone close by talks in chat you cup your ear: "Eh?".
disabilities.condition.mute.you: You cannot chat: you talk with gestures (G key).
disabilities.condition.mute.others: They see your gestures and a bubble with the meaning; if you try to type they hear you mumble.
disabilities.condition.dyslexia.you: Every letter on screen is jumbled.
disabilities.condition.dyslexia.others: Your chat messages arrive with the letters swapped, also in the bubble over your head.
disabilities.condition.wheelchair.you: You are in a wheelchair: no jumping, no ladders; to go up you need stairs or slabs. On sand, gravel, snow and mud you crawl.
disabilities.condition.wheelchair.others: They see you sitting in your wheelchair and hear the wheels squeak.
disabilities.condition.one_leg.you: You walk on crutches: slower, no sprinting, short jumps; you must stop to use your hands.
disabilities.condition.one_leg.others: One leg and two crutches knocking on the ground.
disabilities.condition.one_arm.you: No off hand, no bows, crossbows, tridents or spears; you dig and hit slower.
disabilities.condition.dwarfism.you: You are tiny: shorter reach and slower walking.
disabilities.condition.obesity.you: Slower, twice as hungry, out of breath after a short run, falls hurt more. But you are hard to push around.
disabilities.condition.obesity.others: A huge build, a bouncing belly and panting; the ground shakes when you land.
disabilities.condition.parkinson.you: Your aim always shakes, you often freeze and things slip out of your hand.
disabilities.condition.parkinson.others: Shaking head and arms; you walk bent over, with small shuffling steps.
disabilities.condition.narcolepsy.you: You suddenly fall asleep for a few seconds, also when you get scared, and your eyes keep closing. A friend can wake you with a right click.
disabilities.condition.narcolepsy.others: You yawn, nod off, collapse and snore.
disabilities.condition.tourette.you: Sudden tics: head jerks, jumps, punches at the air, noises and random words, even more when you get hurt.
disabilities.condition.tourette.others: They see the tics, hear the noises and read the words in chat.
disabilities.condition.amnesia.you: No F3, no recipe book or teammates' locator dots, you don't remember the others' names, now and then your inventory gets shuffled and you forget where you are.
disabilities.condition.amnesia.others: You scratch your head with a question mark over it and look around, lost.
disabilities.condition.vertigo.you: The world sways, everything spins near drops, and now and then you stumble.
disabilities.condition.vertigo.others: They see you sway, stagger and trip.
disabilities.condition.asthma.you: Running and jumping take your breath away, and without breath you slow down. Smoke from fires, campfires and lava makes you cough. You have an inhaler.
disabilities.condition.asthma.others: They hear your wheezing and coughing and see you use the inhaler.
disabilities.condition.hemophilia.you: Every wound keeps bleeding until you use a bandage, and now and then your nose bleeds.
disabilities.condition.hemophilia.others: Drops of blood that fall and stay on the ground, also from your nose.
disabilities.condition.allergy.you: Near flowers, grass and animals you sneeze: you jerk, your eyes water and sometimes you drop what you hold.
disabilities.condition.allergy.others: Very loud sneezes, scratching, a red nose and puffy eyes.
disabilities.chooser.title: Choose your two disabilities
disabilities.chooser.subtitle: They are mandatory and last the whole game: the others will see them on you.
disabilities.chooser.hint: Hover a card to read what it does, click to pick it.
disabilities.chooser.taken: Someone else just took it: choose another one.
disabilities.gestures.title: Gestures
disabilities.msg.sunburn: The sun is burning you! Wear a helmet or stay in the shade.
disabilities.msg.one_arm: You have one arm: no off hand.
disabilities.msg.winded: You're out of breath! Stop for a moment.
disabilities.msg.breathless: You can't breathe! Stop or use your inhaler.
disabilities.msg.forgot: Where did I put my things?
disabilities.msg.mute: You are mute: talk with gestures (G key).
disabilities.msg.crutches: Your hands are on the crutches: stop to use them.
disabilities.msg.two_hands: You need two hands for that.
disabilities.hud.asleep: A friend can wake you with a right click
gamerule.disabilities.unique.description: Two players cannot have the same disability.
gamerule.disabilities.reroll_on_death.de: When you die you choose your disabilities again.
gamerule.disabilities.episodes.descripti: Sleep attacks, tics, sneezes, freezes, stumbles and memory lapses.
death.attack.disabilities.sunburn.player: %1$s was burnt by the sun while fleeing %2$s
disabilities.condition.epilepsy.you: Every 8-14 minutes (and after lightning close by, explosions and hard hits) a seizure: a few seconds of warning, then 10-14 seconds convulsing on the ground and half a minute confused. Nothing flashes on screen.
disabilities.condition.epilepsy.others: You collapse and convulse, foaming at the mouth. A right click on you puts you in the recovery position and the seizure ends sooner.
disabilities.condition.alien_hand.you: Your off hand has a mind of its own: it slaps you, throws away what you hold, punches whoever is in front of you, turns your head or waves at nobody.
disabilities.condition.alien_hand.others: A green glove with an eye. The hand slaps you, throws punches and knocks things out of nearby friends' hands.
disabilities.condition.gigantism.you: You are almost 3 blocks tall: longer reach, harder hits and 3 more hearts. But you bump your head, you don't fit through doors or low tunnels, you can't ride horses or boats, you get hungry faster and falls hurt more.
disabilities.condition.gigantism.others: They see a giant and hear you coming: heavy steps that throw up the ground.
disabilities.condition.brittle_bones.you: Falls, explosions and hard hits break your bones. Broken leg: you limp and can't sprint. Broken arm: you dig and hit very slowly. It heals in 4 minutes, in 45 seconds with a cast. You have 3 casts (2 bone meal + paper).
disabilities.condition.brittle_bones.oth: They hear the bones snap and see you with a leg in a cast or an arm in a sling. They can put a cast on you with a right click.
disabilities.condition.weak_heart.you: Running, jumping, swimming, climbing and fighting raise your heart rate, which you see and hear. Over 165 you slow down, at 190 cardiac arrest: someone has 30 seconds to give you CPR.
disabilities.condition.weak_heart.others: A hand on your chest when your heart races. In cardiac arrest you collapse: holding right click on you gives CPR (30 compressions).
disabilities.condition.claustrophobia.yo: In caves, tunnels and small dark rooms the fear grows: the screen closes in, your heart races and you dig slower. When it is full, a panic attack: 12 seconds without hands. In the open it fades; with a friend close by it grows slower.
disabilities.condition.claustrophobia.ot: They see you sweat and look around; in a panic you crouch with your arms over your head, breathing fast.
disabilities.msg.aura: A seizure is coming! Stop somewhere safe.
disabilities.msg.seizure_over: The seizure is over, but your head is still spinning.
disabilities.msg.secured: You put %s in the recovery position.
disabilities.msg.secured_by: %s put you in the recovery position.
disabilities.msg.alien_grabbed_you: %1$s's alien hand knocked it out of your hand: %2$s!
disabilities.msg.too_big: You are too big to get on!
disabilities.msg.broke_leg: You broke a leg! Put a cast on it.
disabilities.msg.broke_arm: You broke an arm! Put a cast on it.
disabilities.msg.broken_arm_hands: With a broken arm you can't use two-handed items.
disabilities.msg.heart_critical: Your heart is pounding too hard! Stop!
disabilities.msg.panic: Panic attack! Get out in the open!
disabilities.msg.panic_hands: You are panicking: you can't use your hands.
disabilities.msg.rough: The wheels sink in: you crawl here.
disabilities.msg.lost: Where am I? What was I doing?
